FAQ

Frequently asked questions about Social Factory. Can't find what you're looking for? Contact us.

G General

What is Social Factory?

+
Social Factory is a blogging platform dedicated to promoting social awareness and compassion. We provide a space for individuals to share stories, raise awareness about social issues, and connect with others who care about making a positive impact in the world.

What does "No Favouritism" mean?

+
"No Favouritism" is our core principle. It means we treat all voices equally, regardless of background, status, or popularity. Every story deserves to be heard, and every person deserves a fair chance to share their perspective. We believe in judging content by its merit and impact, not by who created it.

Is Social Factory free to use?

+
Yes! Social Factory is completely free to use. Anyone can create an account, read articles, and engage with the community at no cost. We believe that access to information and the ability to share ideas should be available to everyone.

Who can create an account?

+
Anyone can create an account! Simply click on the "Register" button, fill in your details, and you'll be ready to join our community. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds who share our values of compassion and equality.

A Account & Profile

How do I reset my password?

+
If you've forgotten your password, click on "Forgot Password" on the login page. Enter your email address, and we'll send you a link to reset your password. If you continue to experience issues, please contact our support team.

Can I change my username?

+
Usernames are permanent and cannot be changed after account creation. However, you can change your display name (nickname) at any time from your profile settings. The display name is what other users see on your posts and comments.

How do I delete my account?

+
To delete your account, go to your Profile settings and scroll to the "Delete Account" section. Please note that this action is permanent and will remove all your posts, comments, and personal data. If you need assistance, contact our support team.

C Content & Posting

How do I publish a post?

+
Once logged in, navigate to your Dashboard and click on "Create New Post". Fill in the title, content, and optionally add a featured image. Choose a category for your post, then click "Publish". Your post will be immediately visible to other users.

What content is allowed?

+
We encourage diverse perspectives and creative expression. However, we do not allow content that promotes hate speech, harassment, violence, or misinformation. Posts should be respectful and contribute positively to the community. Violations may result in content removal or account suspension.

Can I edit or delete my posts?

+
Yes! You can edit or delete your own posts at any time. Go to your Dashboard, find the post you want to modify, and click "Edit" or "Delete". Deleted posts cannot be recovered, so please be certain before confirming.

F Features & Interaction

How do I like or bookmark a post?

+
While reading a post, you'll see a heart icon (♡) to like it and a bookmark icon (📑) to save it for later. Click the heart to show appreciation, and click the bookmark to add it to your "My Bookmarks" page for easy access.

How do comments work?

+
At the bottom of each post, you'll find a comment section. Logged-in users can leave comments, reply to others, and engage in discussions. Comments should be respectful and relevant. Report inappropriate comments using the flag icon.

Can I search for specific topics?

+
Yes! Use the search bar in the navigation menu to find posts by keyword, author, or category. You can also browse posts by category or view the latest posts on the homepage.
